title: Chemical Plant Manager
text:
**Plant Manager**

**\*\*Candidates MUST have experience and a demonstrated track record of success leading complex manufacturing operations---Chemical industry experience REQUIRED\*\***

**Position Summary**

The Plant General Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day operations and performance of the manufacturing facility. This role provides leadership across production, quality, safety, delivery, cost, and continuous improvement to ensure the plant consistently delivers high-quality products on time and within budget.

The ideal candidate is a results-driven, hands-on leader who thrives in a
**fast-paced, complex manufacturing environment**
and has a proven ability to build high-performing teams, drive operational excellence, and deliver sustainable business results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations, including
 **production, quality, safety, delivery, and cost performance**
 .
* Establish and execute operational strategies that support company goals and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure the plant consistently meets or exceeds
 **quality, delivery, productivity, and cost targets**
 .
* Lead and implement continuous improvement initiatives utilizing
 **Lean Manufacturing principles and best practices**
 .
* Analyze production processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, quality, and overall plant profitability.
* Develop, monitor, and manage the plant's
 **annual operating plan, budget, and financial performance**
 .
* Maintain accountability for monthly and annual plant financial results.
* Ensure compliance with all company quality standards and promote a culture focused on
 **quality and customer satisfaction**
 .
* Establish and maintain a safe work environment while ensuring compliance with all company safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure the organization is prepared to effectively respond to plant emergencies and operational disruptions.
* Lead, manage, and develop employees while fostering a culture of
 **trust, accountability, teamwork, and integrity**
 .
* Conduct performance evaluations and establish clear performance expectations for plant personnel.
* Communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization and provide appropriate coaching, counseling, and direction.
* Proactively identify and resolve operational issues, employee conflicts, and performance challenges.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships across all functional areas of the organization.
* Provide leadership and oversight for
 **new product and new program launches**
 , ensuring successful execution and transition into production.
* Promote a positive, professional, and performance-driven culture throughout the facility.

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor's degree required.**
* Significant leadership experience within a
 **complex manufacturing operation**
 .
* Demonstrated track record of successfully managing plant operations and delivering measurable improvements in
 **quality, cost, delivery, safety, and productivity**
 .
* Strong background and working knowledge of
 **Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies**
 .
* Proven experience leading
 **new product/program launches**
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and plant-level P&L responsibility**
 .
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, motivate, and retain high-performing teams.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to effectively delegate responsibility and hold teams accountable for results.
* High degree of professionalism, integrity, tact, and diplomacy.
* Ability to operate effectively in a
 **fast-paced, high-accountability manufacturing environment**
 .
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality and safety standards.

**Ideal Leadership Profile**

The successful candidate will be a
**hands-on, results-oriented manufacturing leader**
who can balance strategic thinking with strong day-to-day operational execution. They should be comfortable working in a demanding environment, making timely decisions, developing people, and driving measurable improvements across the entire plant.

* **The strongest candidates will demonstrate a history of taking ownership of complex manufacturing operations and consistently delivering sustainable improvements in plant performance.**
